overall_summary: Data shows clear audience preference for husband-wife relationship dynamics and domestic emotional realities over generic sad poetry or heavy philosophical lines. Content focusing on married life received the highest engagement (1.6k+ views), while abstract poetry underperformed significantly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,671 views) significantly outperformed all other categories.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more narrative-driven shorts exploring unspoken marital expectations, emotional distance, and small everyday compromises.

winning_patterns.pattern: Direct Relatable Hooks about Family/Loved Ones
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos addressing specific roles like 'Maa' (235 views), 'Papa' (142 views), and relationships ('रिश्ते खत्म नहीं होते' - 288 views) get steady traction compared to abstract heartbreak.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific familial or relational address points in titles rather than vague shayari.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 12 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, cynical, or dark poetry hooks. Keep the tone grounded in bittersweet emotional truth rather than bitterness.
